text: 10月21日，中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅对外发布《关于推动科技创新和产业创新深度融合的意见》，要求以发展新质生产力、建设现代化产业体系为目标，以构建企业主导、各主体协同的产学研融通创新体系为重点，推动全链条贯通、全领域覆盖、全要素融通、全方位保障，形成科技创新和产业创新互融共促新格局。
text_en: On October 21, the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council released the Opinions on Promoting the Deep Integration of Scientific and Technological Innovation with Industrial Innovation, which require aiming to develop new quality productive forces and build a modern industrial system, focusing on building an enterprise-led, multi-entity collaborative system of integrated industry-university-research-application innovation, promoting full-chain connectivity, full-domain coverage, full-factor integration, and all-round support, and forming a new pattern in which scientific and technological innovation and industrial innovation reinforce each other through mutual integration.
